periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the eye patches is oriented at an approximately 45-degree angle descending toward the rostrum relative to the facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the major axis is approximately 1.5 to 1.8 times the length of the minor axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the lowest point of the patch shifted significantly below the geometric center toward the snout.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape across the posterior edge of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High; the dark band occupies approximately 35-40% of the visible dorsal-to-ventral torso height at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation; the gap between the medial edges of the black pinnae is approximately 2.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable chromatic variance between the bright white fur of the head and a distinct yellowish-cream hue on the lower abdominal and flank regions.
